description: A query inside a query, both after token zero. The outer query reads V A B as q, and q asks begins of r over A B. There the longer y → A B sounds "ab", so y≠"xv" holds of it, and the omission of [T] after y → A is forbidden. A library that tests the inner query's positions as the stage's would test the sound "xv" of W V (engine §4).
grammar:
%ambiguity-resolution greedy
%elidable maximal T
%rule text W $s(rest)
%conditions begins($s, q)
%rule rest V A B
%rule q V $t(suffix)
%conditions begins($t, r)
%rule suffix A B
%rule r y≠"xv" [T] B
%rule y A | A B
